Commanders vs 49ers DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, October 19 · NFL Week 6 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 17, 10:56 PM ET

Brock Purdy has the highest SPAGS projection in the Commanders at 49ers DraftKings Showdown: 22.1 points at $10,800 FLEX, 33.2 at captain for $16,200. Across 10,000 simulations Purdy holds 70% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Purdy is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 8.0 points at a $10,800 FLEX salary, in a game with a 52.5-point total.

Christian McCaffrey has the largest captain share: 18.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with McCaffrey at captain. The model gives him 14.6 carries and 5.5 targets. Brock Purdy is the next captain in line, at 18.3%. The model has him running 4.1 times.

San Francisco is a 7.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 30 for the 49ers and 22.5 for the Commanders.

Behind Purdy and McCaffrey, the next projections are Jayden Daniels (20.5, $10,000), George Kittle (16.2, $8,200) and Mike Evans (16.1, $9,600).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 17, 10:56 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Christian McCaffrey, SF RB ($11,800 FLEX / $17,700 CPT)

Christian McCaffrey holds 18.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,700 and the 22.0-point SPAGS model projection becomes 33.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 14.6 carries and 5.5 targets. Across 10,000 simulations McCaffrey averaged 22.0 points with a simulated floor of 9.9 and a ceiling of 40.6. He holds 64% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 18.9% as the captain and 45.6% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Brock Purdy, SF QB ($10,800 FLEX / $16,200 CPT)

Brock Purdy holds 18.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,200 and the 22.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 33.2 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 4.1 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Purdy averaged 22.2 points with a simulated floor of 8.0 and a ceiling of 42.7. He holds 70% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 18.3% as the captain and 51.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Jayden Daniels, WAS QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Jayden Daniels holds 16.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 20.5-point SPAGS model projection becomes 30.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 7.0 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Daniels averaged 20.4 points with a simulated floor of 7.2 and a ceiling of 40.3. He holds 66% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.4% as the captain and 49.8% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Commanders vs 49ers

George Kittle, SF TE ($8,200 FLEX / $12,300 CPT)

George Kittle carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 16.2 DraftKings points for an $8,200 FLEX salary ($12,300 at captain). The model gives him 6.2 targets on 21.4 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Kittle averaged 16.1 points with a simulated floor of 5.2 and a ceiling of 37.1. He holds 49% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.2% as the captain and 36.9% in a FLEX spot.

Mike Evans, SF WR ($9,600 FLEX / $14,400 CPT)

Mike Evans carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 16.1 DraftKings points for a $9,600 FLEX salary ($14,400 at captain). The model gives him 6.7 targets on 19.2 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Evans averaged 16.2 points with a simulated floor of 4.5 and a ceiling of 38.9. He holds 42% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 11.5% as the captain and 30.8% in a FLEX spot.

Rachaad White, WAS RB ($6,600 FLEX / $9,900 CPT)

Rachaad White carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.0 DraftKings points for a $6,600 FLEX salary ($9,900 at captain). The model gives him 10.4 carries and 2.3 targets. Across 10,000 simulations White averaged 11.9 points with a simulated floor of 3.2 and a ceiling of 27.3. He holds 38% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.7% as the captain and 31.6% in a FLEX spot.

Stefon Diggs, WAS WR ($8,400 FLEX / $12,600 CPT)

Stefon Diggs carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.3 DraftKings points for an $8,400 FLEX salary ($12,600 at captain). The model gives him 6.1 targets on 22.0 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Diggs averaged 11.3 points with a simulated floor of 3.9 and a ceiling of 25.2. He holds 26% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.8% as the captain and 23.0% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Drew Stevens, WAS K ($5,000 FLEX / $7,500 CPT)

Drew Stevens projects for 8.2 DraftKings points at a $5,000 FLEX salary, 1.65 projected points per $1,000. Across 10,000 simulations Stevens averaged 8.2 points with a simulated floor of 3.0 and a ceiling of 16.0. He holds 24% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.8% as the captain and 23.5% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Chig Okonkwo, WAS TE ($4,600 FLEX / $6,900 CPT)

Chig Okonkwo projects for 7.0 DraftKings points at a $4,600 FLEX salary, 1.52 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 3.6 targets on 19.4 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Okonkwo averaged 6.8 points with a simulated floor of 0.2 and a ceiling of 22.1. He holds 20% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 3.2% as the captain and 17.2% in a FLEX spot.

Commanders vs 49ers DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Commanders vs 49ers DraftKings Showdown?

Christian McCaffrey holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 18.9%, ahead of Brock Purdy (18.3%) and Jayden Daniels (16.4%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Commanders vs 49ers?

Build around George Kittle at captain with Brock Purdy, Jayden Daniels and Mike Evans at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (14 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $7,300 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Commanders vs 49ers DraftKings Showdown?

Brock Purdy leads the SPAGS model at 22.1 DraftKings points for $10,800 at FLEX, or 33.2 points at captain for $16,200.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Commanders vs 49ers Showdown?

Christian McCaffrey is the most expensive player at $11,800 FLEX and $17,700 at captain. All 30 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Commanders vs 49ers DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Drew Stevens (8.2 points at $5,000), Chig Okonkwo (7.0 points at $4,600) and Austin Ekeler (5.4 points at $3,600).

What is the Commanders vs 49ers spread and total?

The 49ers are a 7.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 52.5, with implied team totals of 30 for the 49ers and 22.5 for the Commanders.
